question: Among frozen C-M V1 candidates, do those with a structurally identified company event in the primary event window show stronger forward close drift than matched controls and than candidates without an event?

unchanged: C-M0/M1/M2 conditions and thresholds (return_1d, return_5d, rvol_20, rs_spy_*, distance_52w_high)
universe, hard filter, history requirements, corporate-action exclusions
feature formulas and candidate timestamp (signal after D's regular close)
matching cell (signal_date, price_bucket, atr_bucket, adv20_bucket), control population, min 5 label-valid controls
labels: P0 = open(D+1) split-normalized, close_return_k, mfe_k, mae_k, clip [-1, 1], label CA suspicion D..D+10, DISAPPEARED censoring
baseline_frozen.no_tuning: no C-M parameter, bucket edge or control rule may be changed to rescue C-E0
baseline_frozen.snapshot_requirement: C-E1 runs on the common historical snapshot. It must reproduce the V1 C-M0 candidate set on the V1 primary dates (same ticker-date rows) before any event join, else the run aborts. Snapshot ID and digest are recorded in the run manifest.

prior_knowledge: V1 summary and V2A (read before this declaration) report all C-M0 candidates vs matched controls: close excess -0.10/-0.13/-0.01/-0.06 %p at horizons 1/3/5/10, CIs containing 0; V2A found no positive D+1..D+5 cell.

Consequence stated in advance: EM and M_ONLY are a split of a pool whose total excess is about 0, so a positive EM excess implies a negative M_ONLY excess of roughly the same weighted size. H1 and H2 are therefore positively correlated and are required jointly, never traded off.
No event statistic, event count or event-candidate overlap has been computed or looked at. The 5-day primary horizon is taken from the request, not chosen from data.

base_variant.why: V1 showed C-M1's RS conditions add almost no information over return_5d, and C-M2 cuts 55% of candidates with lower lift. One variant keeps the primary test at exactly two hypotheses.

evaluation_window.primary: the V1 primary signal dates (session-grid index 251..N-10 of the V1 grid, 2025-09-18..2026-09-01, 240 dates), unchanged even if the common snapshot is longer
evaluation_window.secondary: V1 secondary dates (index 60..N-10) for C-M0, descriptive
evaluation_window.extension: dates of a longer common snapshot outside the V1 grid are reported as C-E0-EXT, descriptive, never a gate input
evaluation_window.time_blocks: the 240 primary dates split into 4 consecutive blocks of (near) equal date count, same split as V1

pit.clock: America/New_York; XNYS session calendar incl. early closes (session close = scheduled close of that day, 13:00 on half days)
pit.acceptance_time: EDGAR acceptanceDateTime; filingDate is never used as the event time
pit.timezone_audit: before any join, C-E1 compares the submissions-JSON acceptanceDateTime with the ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME header of the filing's .txt/index on >= 30 accessions spread over the range (incl. after-hours and DST-boundary filings). The zone interpretation (ET vs UTC) is fixed by that audit; any mismatch it cannot explain -> GATE-CE0 = INCONCLUSIVE (PIT_UNCERTAIN).

effective_time.during_session: acceptance inside [open, close) of a session -> effective_time = acceptance
effective_time.before_open: acceptance before the open of a session day -> effective_time = that session's open
effective_time.after_close_or_non_session: acceptance at/after a session's close, or on a non-session day -> effective_time = next session's open

pit.missing_acceptance: a filing of a listed class without acceptanceDateTime whose filingDate is within [D-3, D+1] sessions -> EVENT_STATUS = UNKNOWN_PIT
pit.post_signal_events: effective_time in [close(D), open(D+1)] are never events of D; recorded as post_signal_event_flag, descriptive only
pit.signal_time: the C-M signal exists after close(D); entry is open(D+1). Nothing with effective_time >= close(D) may affect cohort membership.

primary.meaning: from the open of the second session before D to D's regular close; filings accepted after close(D-3) or overnight before D-2 enter through the before_open/after_close rules

event_windows.negative_risk_window: same as W_PRIMARY for cohort assignment; a separate descriptive flag recent_dilution_20 covers E4 in [open(D-20), close(D))
event_windows.ma_target_pin_window: [open(D-60), close(D)) as fixed in the taxonomy
event_windows.frozen: no window may be changed after any event statistic is seen

cik_mapping.source: cik field of the Massive CS reference snapshot with the latest as_of <= D (the same snapshots V1 used for eligibility)
cik_mapping.join_key: CIK; ticker text is never a join key
cik_mapping.missing: no CIK in that snapshot -> EVENT_STATUS = UNKNOWN_MAPPING (never NO_EVENT)
cik_mapping.inconsistent: the same ticker mapped to a different CIK in an adjacent snapshot while D lies between them -> UNKNOWN_MAPPING for dates between the two as_of values
cik_mapping.active_filer_check: the CIK must have at least one EDGAR filing of any form with filingDate in [D-400 calendar days, D]; otherwise UNKNOWN_MAPPING
cik_mapping.coverage: the submissions fetch of a CIK must cover [D-60 sessions, D+1 session]; a failed or truncated fetch -> UNKNOWN_COVERAGE

event_status_and_cohorts.one_row_per_candidate: a candidate is one row with event_count, event_types[], event_accessions[], negative_risk_flag, negative_risk_types[], ma_target_pin_flag, post_signal_event_flag, recent_dilution_20, routine_count and the status per secondary window
event_status_and_cohorts.event_count: number of distinct dedup event keys of classes E1, E2, E3, E5 in W_PRIMARY
assignment_order: missing acceptance rule, or a listed-class filing whose window membership cannot be decided
any E4 event in W_PRIMARY (with or without E1/E2/E3/E5)
event_count >= 1 and no E4 event in W_PRIMARY
no E1..E5 event in W_PRIMARY (IGNORED/routine filings allowed)

primary_cohorts.EM: C-M0 candidate AND material event present (E1/E2/E3/E5) AND negative_risk_flag = false AND not excluded/unknown
primary_cohorts.M_ONLY: C-M0 candidate AND no E1..E5 event in W_PRIMARY AND not excluded/unknown

event_status_and_cohorts.not_in_c_e0: E-only cohort (event without C-M), event-conditioned controls, any POSITIVE_EVENT variable
event_status_and_cohorts.controls: matched controls are the V1 C-M0 controls and are not event-classified; H1 compares EM with the ordinary matched base

outcomes.primary: close_return_5 = C(last traded session in D+1..D+5) / open(D+1) - 1, split-normalized, clipped [-1, 1]
outcomes.mfe_rule: MFE/MAE never substitute for the close-return gate
outcomes.validity: V1 LabelSet validity at horizon k (entry bar, no label CA suspicion D..D+10, not DISAPPEARED at k); a candidate is matched at k if its cell has >= 5 controls valid at k
outcomes.cost_reference: 0.25%p round trip printed beside every excess, not a gate input

statistics.excess: for a cohort G at horizon k: (sum over matched valid candidates of close_k - sum of their cell control means) / N_G, aggregated per signal date so dates are the resampling unit (the V1 _diff_ci estimator)
statistics.H2_difference: excess_EM - excess_M_ONLY, both computed on the same bootstrap draw of dates
statistics.bootstrap: moving block bootstrap over the 240 primary signal dates, block length 10 sessions, 10000 replicates, seed 20260918
statistics.multiplicity: C-E0 needs H1 AND H2 (intersection-union test), so each is tested at 5% without Bonferroni; 10D and every descriptive number are not tests
statistics.also_reported: median of per-candidate (close_5 - cell control mean) for EM and M_ONLY; 99% CIs

H1_absolute.statement: EM 5D close excess over matched controls > 0

H2_incremental.statement: EM 5D close excess - M_ONLY 5D close excess > 0

secondary_descriptive.H_reversion: M_ONLY 5D close excess < 0 (no-news moves revert); reported, never a gate

pre_outcome_checks.meaning: evaluated from cohort membership and label validity only, before any forward return is read. If one fails the run stops with GATE-CE0 = INCONCLUSIVE and no outcome is computed.

checks.P2_pit_audit: violations == 0 (see pit_audit); a violation found here is a bug, fixed and re-audited before outcomes, not a gate failure
checks.P3_unknown_share: UNKNOWN_MAPPING + UNKNOWN_COVERAGE + UNKNOWN_PIT + UNKNOWN_FORM <= 10% of C-M0 primary candidates
checks.P4_em_sample: EM matched and valid at k=5 >= 300
checks.P6_m_only_sample: M_ONLY matched and valid at k=5 >= 300
checks.P7_block_sample: EM matched valid at k=5 >= 30 in each of the 4 time blocks
checks.P8_window: all 240 V1 primary dates present in the snapshot

pre_outcome_checks.no_threshold_relief: a failed pre-outcome check is never lowered; the answer is INCONCLUSIVE

checks: every event in W_PRIMARY has effective_time < close(D)
no event with effective_time >= close(D) changes cohort membership (recompute cohorts after deleting all such filings: identical)
mutation: shift every effective_time by +1 session; only candidates whose events cross the window edge may change cohort, all changes are explained
positive control: inject a synthetic filing at close(D) + 1 second for sampled candidates; the audit must flag it
no /A filing creates an event; no filingDate-only filing is placed without acceptance
CIK used for D came from a snapshot with as_of <= D
pit_audit.after_outcomes: a PIT violation discovered after outcomes were computed makes this declaration's gate FAIL; a new declaration is required to retry

conditions.6_time_blocks: EM - M_ONLY 5D excess point > 0 in >= 3 of 4 blocks AND EM 5D excess point > 0 in >= 3 of 4 blocks

8_concentration.leave_one_class_out: for every event class with >= 10% of EM candidates: dropping EM candidates of that class keeps condition 1 and 3 point estimates > 0
8_concentration.leave_top5_tickers_out: dropping EM rows of the 5 most frequent EM tickers keeps condition 1 and 3 point estimates > 0
8_concentration.event_scope: if one class carries > 60% of EM candidates, a PASS is recorded with scope = that class and may not be described as 'events in general'

decision.INCONCLUSIVE: any pre-outcome check fails (sample, coverage, CIK mapping, PIT uncertainty, window); decided before outcomes
decision.PASS: all 9 conditions met -> C-EM Selection V1 becomes a development candidate (a new declaration, out-of-sample requirement, costs)
decision.FAIL: pre-outcome checks passed and any of conditions 1..9 fails. Typical: no EM close edge, only MFE higher, EM ~ M_ONLY, EM < M_ONLY, dependence on one class/ticker/period, PIT problem after outcomes

gate.per_hypothesis_record: H1 = conditions 1-2, H2 = conditions 3-4, each recorded PASS/FAIL separately

termination_rule.on_fail: GATE-CE0 = FAIL ends the Strategy C directional thesis. If H1 and H2 both fail this is recorded as the explicit case of the termination rule.
forbidden_after_fail: switching the primary horizon or base variant
termination_rule.volatility_work: may continue only as a separately named strategy idea with its own declaration; it is not a continuation of Strategy C

required_tables.incremental: EM - M_ONLY for 5D close excess, 10D close excess, MFE5/MFE10 excess, MAE5/MAE10 excess, with 95% CI
required_tables.time_blocks: per block: N_EM, N_M_ONLY, EM excess, M_ONLY excess, difference
required_tables.concentration: N by event class, N by ticker (top 10 and shares), N by date (top 10 and shares), class share of EM
required_tables.status_counts: every EVENT_STATUS with counts and share of C-M0 primary candidates
required_tables.secondary_windows: W_D5, W_D1, W_D0 versions of the main and incremental tables, labelled DESCRIPTIVE

execution_order_after_snapshot_id: 1 user fixes the SEC User-Agent identifier
2 build the SEC event raw store for the CIKs of C-M0 candidates (and nothing that reads C-M outcomes)
3 form-code alias audit (taxonomy addendum only if needed, checksummed) and timezone audit
4 reproduce V1 C-M0 candidates on the snapshot, join events by CIK, assign statuses
5 PIT audit and pre-outcome checks P1..P8 (INCONCLUSIVE stops here)
6 compute outcomes, H1/H2 tests and the required tables
7 decide GATE-CE0 from this file only
